أين تُنشر أسماء المقبولين في الموازي؟: Where are the names of those admitted to the parallel program published?
تنشر كل جامعة رسمية قوائم المقبولين في ا: Each public university publishes the lists of students admitted to the parallel program on its official website (usually on the Admission and Registration Department page or the announcements page), often in batches. The parallel program is specific to each university and outside unified admission, so there is no single website that gathers all the results.
لماذا تُنشر القوائم على دفعات؟: Why are the lists published in batches?
تعلن الجامعات المقبولين على دفعات متتالي: Universities announce those admitted in successive batches (first, second...) depending on available seats, so if you do not find your name in the first batch, follow the announcements of later batches on the university's website.
ماذا أفعل بعد أن أجد اسمي؟: What do I do after I find my name?
يرافق كل إعلان قبول مواعيد ورابط لاستكما: Every admission announcement comes with dates and a link to complete the admission procedures (and pay fees online at some universities) — stick to the deadline stated in your university's announcement, because being late may cancel the admission.
